how it works

How it works

1

You show the QR at your counter

Print it, prop up a phone, or use a tablet. The QR is always ready.

2

A customer scans it with their phone camera and signs in with their number

No app download. They open the camera, scan, enter their mobile number, and get a one-time code.

3

A stamp lands on their card

One visit, one stamp. The card fills up right on their phone.

4

Some visits give a scratch card with a prize you set

You decide the prizes, the odds, and how many. The result is decided on our server, not the phone.

5

When the card is full they claim a reward and you confirm it at the counter

They get a one-time code, show it to you, and you tap Confirm. Done.

benefits

Benefits for shopkeepers

Customers who come back

Automatic reminders nudge people when a reward is ready or when they have not visited for a while. You do nothing.

Know every regular by name

See who visited, when, and how many stamps they have.

No paper to print, lose or fake

The card lives on the customer’s phone. Nobody can stamp it at home.

Stamps that cannot be faked

The QR at your counter changes every few seconds, so a photo of it is useless, and a cooldown stops repeat scans.

Scratch cards on your terms

You choose the prizes, the odds and how many of each you give away. The server decides the result, not the phone.

Nothing to buy

Show the QR on any phone or tablet. No terminal, no stamp pad, no printer.

You stay in charge

Change the stamps needed, the reward, the prizes and the cooldown whenever you like. Approve visits yourself if you prefer. Void a stamp with a reason.

A clear record

Every stamp, prize and redemption is logged, so you can see exactly what happened if someone disputes a stamp.

questions

Common questions

Do my customers need an app?

No. They scan with the phone camera, sign in with their mobile number and the card opens in the browser. They can add it to the home screen.

What do customers share?

Their name and mobile number. We text a one-time code to confirm the number.

Can customers cheat by scanning from home?

The QR changes every few seconds, each customer can collect once per cooldown you set, and you can approve visits yourself.

Do I need any equipment?

A phone or tablet that shows the QR.

How do scratch cards work?

You set the prizes, the odds and the stock. The result is decided on our server. Winners show a one-time code and you confirm it.

How does a customer claim a reward?

They tap Claim, get a one-time code valid for 10 minutes and show it at the counter.

Will customers get reminders?

Yes, as browser notifications. On iPhone they work after the site is added to the home screen.

What does it cost?

[[FILL: pricing details]]

Who sees my customers' data?

Only you, for your shop. [[FILL: owner to confirm "we do not sell data"]]

What if my internet drops?

The QR stops changing and customers cannot collect until you are back online.

Can I run more than one shop?

Not yet. Each shop has its own program for now.
